name: Tarpon Springs
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Tarpon Springs, FL 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Tarpon Springs, Florida for 2026: snow slides, Santa, two boat and golf cart parades and a Christmas parade, all free.
lede: Tarpon Springs packs its holiday season into three December weekends of snow slides, a boat parade on the Anclote River, a Christmas parade and a golf cart parade.
celebrates: The City of Tarpon Springs calls Snow Place Like Tarpon Springs the biggest Christmas celebration in North Pinellas, a free night of snow slides, Santa and letters to Santa in historic downtown on December 4. The 37th annual Holiday Boat Parade follows from Tarpon Landing Marina down the Anclote River to Craig Park, according to Visit St. Pete/Clearwater. The Tarpon Springs Chamber of Commerce presents the Christmas Parade on December 12, and the Downtown District's Christmas Golf Cart Parade rolls on December 19 to benefit Shop with a Cop.
lastyear: We did not find a published recap of Tarpon Springs' 2025 events, so this page leans on 2026 listings. The tourism bureau counts the December 4 boat parade as the 37th annual, which means the first parade ran 36 years ago. The Sponge Docks golf cart parade listing uses a 2025 photo, showing the event was held last year.
facts: Tarpon Springs' Sponge Docks district runs along Dodecanese Boulevard, where the tourism bureau says five public parking lots serve boat parade viewers. The parade ends at Craig Park and Spring Bayou, and sightseeing companies such as Spongeorama Cruise Lines and Odyssey Cruises offer evening cruises during the parade. The Tarpon Springs Yacht Club, at 350 North Spring Boulevard, starts and ends the golf cart parade.
trains: We did not find a Christmas train ride in Tarpon Springs. For rail history, the Florida Railroad Museum in Parrish and the Henry B. Plant Museum in Tampa are listed on our museum guide, and Largo's Rudolph Limited holiday train is listed on our Largo page.
train_links: A heritage railroad museum south of Tampa Bay, listed on our museum guide.

traditions: A free December 4 downtown celebration with snow slides, Santa and letters to Santa.
The 37th annual parade on the Anclote River, December 4.
The Chamber of Commerce's downtown parade on December 12.
Decorated golf carts on December 19, with proceeds to Shop with a Cop.
kidfact: The Tarpon Springs boat parade has run for 37 years, and boats compete for trophies for the best decorations.
faq: How does Tarpon Springs celebrate Christmas?
With a free downtown night of snow slides and Santa on December 4, a boat parade the same evening, a Christmas parade on December 12 and a golf cart parade on December 19.
Is there a boat parade in Tarpon Springs?
Yes. The 37th annual Holiday Boat Parade is Friday, December 4, 2026, from 7 to 8:30 pm, ending at Craig Park and Spring Bayou, according to Visit St. Pete/Clearwater.
Are Tarpon Springs Christmas events free?
The four events on this page are free to attend, according to their city and tourism listings.
Where can kids meet Santa in Tarpon Springs?
The city lists a visit with Santa at Snow Place Like Tarpon Springs on December 4, and says you may catch a glimpse of Santa at the Christmas Parade on December 12.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Tarpon Springs for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from the Sponge Docks Christmas Tree Lighting (December 3) through the Christmas Golf Cart Parade (December 19), with Snow Place Like Tarpon Springs and the Holiday Boat Parade (December 4) and the Tarpon Springs Christmas Parade (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

  • Parades and tree lightings: Sponge Docks Christmas Tree Lighting (December 3), Holiday Boat Parade (December 4), Christmas Parade (December 12) and Christmas Golf Cart Parade (December 19)
